import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
def build(w):
    s=np.sin(w*t); c_=np.cos(w*t)
    return np.c_[np.ones_like(t),x,v,s,c_,x*s,x*c_,v*s,v*c_,x*x,v*v,x*v,t*s,t*c_]
def f(w):
    X=build(w); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((X@c-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt)
w=minimize_scalar(f,bounds=(0.6,0.8),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-10}).x
X=build(w); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)
print(w, f(w)); print(np.round(c,4))
# also try w-free Fourier with 2 harmonics
X2=np.c_[np.ones_like(t),x,v,np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t),np.sin(2*w*t),np.cos(2*w*t)]
c2,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X2,dv_dt,rcond=None); print(np.mean((X2@c2-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt), np.round(c2,4))
